def load() -> pd.DataFrame:
    import glob
    import pandas as pd

    pattern = 'data/astronomy/input/STORM-AI/warmup/v2/Sat_Density/swarma-*2015*.csv'
    paths = sorted(glob.glob(pattern))
    if not paths:
        raise FileNotFoundError(f'No files matched pattern: {pattern}')

    dfs = []
    for p in paths:
        df = pd.read_csv(p)
        df['__source_file'] = p.split('/')[-1]
        dfs.append(df)

    out = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)
    return out

operators.customDisplayName: Load all Swarm Alpha atmospheric density CSVs matching pattern swarma-*2015*.csv (glob) from Sat_Density/; read each via pd.read_csv, add provenance column __source_file (basename), and concatenate into a single DataFrame

def process(loadInitialStates, loadSwarmDensity2015):
    import pandas as pd
    import numpy as np

    # --- initial states: keep 2015, midnight timestamps, altitude window ---
    ist = loadInitialStates.copy()
    ist['Timestamp'] = pd.to_datetime(ist['Timestamp'], errors='coerce')
    ist = ist.dropna(subset=['Timestamp'])

    # Ensure exactly 00:00:00 (should already be, but enforce)
    ist = ist[ist['Timestamp'].dt.time == pd.Timestamp('00:00:00').time()]
    ist = ist[ist['Timestamp'].dt.year == 2015]
    ist = ist[(ist['Altitude (km)'] >= 450) & (ist['Altitude (km)'] <= 500)]

    # unique daily timestamps at midnight
    midnightDays = ist[['Timestamp']].drop_duplicates()

    # --- density: parse, keep 2015 only, clean invalid values ---
    den = loadSwarmDensity2015.copy()
    den['Timestamp'] = pd.to_datetime(den['Timestamp'], errors='coerce')
    den = den.dropna(subset=['Timestamp'])

    den = den[den['Timestamp'].dt.year == 2015]

    col = 'Orbit Mean Density (kg/m^3)'
    den[col] = pd.to_numeric(den[col], errors='coerce')
    # Clean n/a (becomes NaN) and 9.99E32 sentinel (and any extremely large ~1e33 values)
    den.loc[den[col].isin([9.99e32, 9.989999999999999e32]), col] = np.nan
    den.loc[den[col] > 1e30, col] = np.nan

    # Keep only 00:00 density measurements
    den = den[den['Timestamp'].dt.time == pd.Timestamp('00:00:00').time()]

    # Join on timestamp to keep only days present in initial state subset
    joined = midnightDays.merge(den[['Timestamp', col]], on='Timestamp', how='inner')

    avg = joined[col].mean(skipna=True)

    return pd.DataFrame([
        {
            'n_initialstate_days_alt450_500': int(midnightDays.shape[0]),
            'n_matched_density_midnights': int(joined.shape[0]),
            'avg_density_kg_m3': avg,
        }
    ])

operators.customDisplayName: Compute average Swarm Alpha Orbit Mean Density (kg/m^3) at 00:00 for 2015 days that appear in initial-states file and have altitude in [450, 500] km: filter initial states to Timestamp year=2015 and time==00:00:00 and Altitude (km) between 450 and 500; deduplicate timestamps; filter density table to year=2015 and time==00:00:00; coerce Orbit Mean Density to numeric and set invalid/sentinel values (n/a->NaN, 9.99E32 and any >1e30) to NaN; inner-join on Timestamp; compute mean density across matched midnights and return mean plus counts.
